items.title: The largest expansion of ClickHouse yet
items.summary: ClickHouse Managed Postgres is generally available, ClickHouse Observability enters public beta, ClickHouse Security launches in private preview, Langfuse introduces an open-source AI Gateway, and ClickHouse acquires Xata.

items.title: ClickHouse Unifies Enterprise AI Data Stack with Launch of Expanded Platform
items.summary: Now serving more than 5,000 customers, ClickHouse is introducing new capabilities spanning Postgres, observability and security, alongside its acquisition of Xata, challenging established vendors across the enterprise.

items.title: Introducing ClickHouse Security in private preview, built on RunReveal
items.summary: ClickHouse Security, an agentic SIEM built on RunReveal and ClickHouse Cloud, is now in private preview, with AI agents, 100+ integrations and built-in detections running on your own ClickHouse service.

items.title: Langfuse launches AI Gateway
items.summary: One open source entry point for all AI usage in your company. See every model call, who made it and what it cost, natively traced in Langfuse.

items.title: The observability UI as we know it is dead. So what comes next?
items.summary: Your observability UI shouldn't limit the questions you can ask. Explore how ClickHouse Observability Apps turns a prompt into custom investigation experiences, why SQL makes it possible, and what we still need to get right.

items.title: Announcing ClickHouse Observability - fully managed observability on ClickHouse Cloud
items.summary: Introducing ClickHouse Observability: fully managed observability with the speed and scale of ClickHouse. Just send telemetry; we'll handle the rest. Plus, build the observability experience you've always wanted with a simple prompt in Observability Apps.

items.title: ClickHouse Managed Postgres goes GA and Xata acquisition brings agentic capabilities to the service
items.summary: ClickHouse Managed Postgres, our NVMe-backed Postgres service natively connected to ClickHouse, is generally available, and we're acquiring Xata to add instant branching, cloning and scale-to-zero for developers and AI agents.
